subject.title: feat(repair): import clusters from Gitcrawl cloud

question: After the crawl-remote dependencies deploy, does the protected-main cloud/parity run demonstrate a sufficiently narrow OIDC trust policy and safe reader-only publication path to approve this workflow permission change?
rationale: Unit tests and static checks cannot establish the deployed GitHub Actions identity claims, remote trust policy, token lifetime, service behavior, and publication boundary; a maintainer must assess the live proof before this security-sensitive automation is enabled.

options.title: Wait for protected-main proof
options.body: Keep the PR draft until the dependencies deploy and redacted cloud and parity runs prove the exact OIDC, evidence, and publication paths.

options.title: Pause remote intake
options.body: Leave scheduled intake local-only and defer this consumer until the remote trust boundary has an independently reviewed deployment record.

recommendation.title: Wait for protected-main proof
